root_cause: The obligation terminalizer required candidate SHA ancestry under the merge SHA. A protected squash merge creates a new merge commit rather than preserving the candidate commit as an ancestor, and merged-branch cleanup can also remove the candidate ref before the terminalizer validates it.
prevention_rule: Post-merge lineage verification must explicitly fetch the candidate SHA and accept either direct ancestry or exact candidate-tree/merge-tree equivalence, while still requiring the merge SHA to be contained in current main. Any other state fails closed.
